title: Jonah and the Inheritance
author: Coral Joubert
blurb: Ansel Lockridge, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
